name: hcapp_getEventMessages
description: Returns all messages for a specific event, ordered newest first. Auth token is event-bound: compound of DeviceSecret + CAST(@eventId AS NVARCHAR(50)). Author data is returned as flat columns (authorId, authorFirstName, authorImageUrl) rather than a nested JSON string. hcapp_getEventMessages and hcapp_getEventMessages2 are merged into this single SP.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID for auth lookup.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Event-bound access token. Validated against DeviceSecret + CAST(@eventId AS NVARCHAR(50)) inside HC6.ValidateAppAuth (SP number 60).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Internal event ID to retrieve messages for. A NULL value passes the zero UUID as the token suffix before the explicit null check fires, causing an auth failure before the null validation error is reached.

rowsets.name: AuthOrValidationError
rowsets.description: Returned when ValidateAppAuth fails (auth) or @eventId is NULL (param validation). errorType 11 = auth failure from ValidateAppAuth; errorType 12 = null @eventId. SP RETURNs after either error.

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: All messages for the event on success, ordered by createdAt DESC. Author identity is returned as flat columns joined from HC.Hasher.

columns.name: id
columns.description: EventMessage.id uppercased via UPPER(). Returned as string, not typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: roomId
columns.description: EventMessage.PublicEventId. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds computed via DATEDIFF_BIG(MILLISECOND, '1970-01-01', msg.createdAt).

columns.name: authorId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId uppercased via UPPER(). NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: authorFirstName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — computed persisted column derived from HashName/FirstName/LastName. Nullable when all name fields are empty (falls back to '<no names provided>').

columns.name: authorImageUrl
columns.description: Hasher.Photo. NULL when hasher has no profile photo.

sideEffects: Inserts a row into HC.ErrorLog when @eventId is NULL

codeSmells.issue: NULL @eventId may cause auth failure before param validation
codeSmells.detail: When @eventId is NULL, @paramSuffix is set to the zero UUID string ('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') and passed to ValidateAppAuth. If the token was not generated for that zero UUID, ValidateAppAuth will return an auth error (errorType 11) before the explicit @eventId IS NULL check fires. The caller sees an auth error instead of a parameter error, which is misleading.

The SP has SET XACT_ABORT ON but no TRY/CATCH wrapper. An unhandled runtime error (e.g. INNER JOIN against a missing Hasher row due to data integrity issue) will surface as a raw SQL exception rather than a structured error rowset.

codeSmells.issue: Removed messages not filtered from result
codeSmells.detail: EventMessage has a Removed column (SMALLINT). The SELECT does not filter WHERE msg.Removed = 0, so soft-deleted messages are returned to the caller.

codeSmells.issue: id and authorId returned as uppercased strings, not typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
codeSmells.detail: UPPER(msg.id) and UPPER(h.PublicHasherId) cause SQL Server to return these as NVARCHAR rather than UNIQUEIDENTIFIER. Flutter callers must normalise to lowercase using normalizeUuid() / .asUuid before comparison or map lookup.

breakingChanges: HC5 hcapp_getEventMessages 'author' column (nested JSON string via FOR JSON PATH) removed — replaced with three flat columns: authorId (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), authorFirstName (DisplayName), authorImageUrl (Photo)
HC5 hcapp_getEventMessages2 SP removed — its flat-column behaviour is now the only rowset format returned by this SP
Error rowset shape changed: HC5 included debugMessage column; HC6 error rowset omits debugMessage and adds errorCode
Auth token compound formula unchanged (DeviceSecret + CAST(@eventId AS NVARCHAR(50))), but token is now validated via centralised HC6.ValidateAppAuth instead of inline logic
